The log-forwarder sidecar in search-api 4.8.0 lacks CPU resource requests. Per Kubernetes docs, missing resource requests on any pod container prevent HPA CPU metrics: "if some of the Pod's containers do not have the relevant resource request set, CPU utilization for the Pod will not be defined and the autoscaler will not take any action for that metric" [cite: concepts/workloads/autoscaling/horizontal-pod-autoscale#how-does-a-horizontalpodautoscaler-work-3].
